args.title: Fix README's Running locally section to use correct npm script
args.body: File: README.md. The "Running locally" section instructs users to run `npm run serve`, but package.json defines no `serve` script, only `start` (node dist/index.js), `build`, `test`, and `lint`. Update the README to replace `npm run serve` with the correct command (e.g. `npm run build` followed by `npm start`, or whichever sequence matches the intended local-dev workflow) so new contributors aren't blocked by a "Missing script" error.
